description: This file implements the core logic for WAN mode management in a device configuration system, including enabling/disabling WAN interfaces, setting WAN modes, handling system updates, and reacting to configuration changes. It contains functions to initialize the WAN manager, get and set WAN configurations, manage interface states, and respond to events related to IP modes and sensing policies.

classes.name: wan_mode_status_t
classes.description: Enumeration representing the status of a WAN mode (Enabled, Disabled, Error).

classes.name: mode_cnv_t
classes.description: Structure for mapping mode control enums to their string representations.

methods.name: bool system_module_loaded(void)
methods.description: Checks if the system module has been loaded successfully.

methods.name: bool autosensing_can_start(void)
methods.description: Determines if autosensing can be initiated based on current configurations.

methods.name: void update_sensing(void)
methods.description: Triggers update of sensing configurations based on current policies.

methods.name: void wan_mode_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the WAN manager object and loads necessary modules.

methods.name: amxd_object_t * get_wan_manager_obj(void)
methods.description: Returns the current WAN manager object.

methods.name: void wan_mode_cleanup(void)
methods.description: Cleans up and resets the WAN manager object pointer.

methods.name: physical_type_t get_physical_type_by_reference(const char * physical_reference)
methods.description: Returns the physical type enum based on a string reference.

methods.name: physical_type_t get_physical_type(amxd_object_t * wan_mode)
methods.description: Retrieves the physical type for a given WAN mode object.

methods.name: amxd_status_t check_sfp(void)
methods.description: Checks if the SFP module is loaded correctly and retrieves its type.

methods.name: void wan_manager_found_ll(physical_type_t found_phys_type)
methods.description: Handles logic when a WAN manager link-layer interface is found, enabling or disabling WAN modes accordingly.

methods.name: void startup_wan_autosensing(void)
methods.description: Starts autosensing process based on current configurations.

methods.name: void update_operation_mode(const char * new_operation_mode,const char * sensing_policy,bool override_boot)
methods.description: Updates the operation mode of the WAN manager, initiating autosensing if necessary.

methods.name: amxd_status_t wan_mode_dm_set(const char * wan_mode,const char * operation_mode)
methods.description: Sets the WAN mode and operation mode in the device data model.

methods.name: bool wan_mode_different_physical_type(const char * current_wan_modes,UNUSED const char * new_wan_modes)
methods.description: Compares current and new WAN modes to determine if a physical type change occurs.

methods.name: amxd_status_t wan_mode_set(const char * wan_modes_to_set,const char * active_wan_modes)
methods.description: Main function to set new WAN modes, enabling/disabling interfaces and updating the data model.

methods.name: amxd_status_t wan_mode_intf_enable(amxd_object_t * interface,const char * wanmode_name,nm_query_ll_info_t * ll_info,bool enable,const char * ipv4_mode_ovr,const char * ipv6_mode_ovr)
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific WAN interface, managing bridging and VLAN configurations.

methods.name: amxd_status_t wan_mode_enable(amxd_object_t * wan_mode,bool enable)
methods.description: Enables or disables a WAN mode object and its associated interfaces, managing DNS and upstream settings.

methods.name: amxd_object_t * get_wan_mode(const char * alias)
methods.description: Retrieves a WAN mode object from the data model by alias.

methods.name: const char * get_current_wan_mode_str(void)
methods.description: Gets the current WAN mode as a string from the data model.

methods.name: const char * wan_mode_status_to_str(wan_mode_status_t status)
methods.description: Converts a WAN mode status enum to its string representation.

methods.name: amxd_status_t wan_mode_set_status(amxd_object_t * const object,wan_mode_status_t status)
methods.description: Sets the status of a WAN mode object (Enabled, Disabled, Error).

methods.name: mode_ctrl_t wan_mode_convert_from_str(const char * mode,const ipversion_t ipversion)
methods.description: Converts a string mode to its corresponding mode control enum, considering IP version.

methods.name: mode_ctrl_t get_wan_mode_type(amxd_object_t * interface,bool include_type,const char * custom_ipv4_mode,const char * custom_ipv6_mode)
methods.description: Determines the WAN mode type for an interface, including protocol and link-layer info.

methods.name: void _update_autosensing(UNUSED const char * const event_name,const amxc_var_t * const event_data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Event handler for updating autosensing based on operation mode changes.

methods.name: void _update_sensing_policy(UNUSED const char * const event_name,UNUSED const amxc_var_t * const event_data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Event handler for updating sensing policies.

methods.name: void _wan_sensing_toggled(UNUSED const char * const event_name,UNUSED const amxc_var_t * const event_data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Event handler for sensing toggle events.

methods.name: void _wan_sensing_priority_changed(UNUSED const char * const event_name,UNUSED const amxc_var_t * const event_data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Handles changes in sensing priority.

methods.name: void ip_mode_toggled(const amxc_var_t * const event_data,const ipversion_t ipversion)
methods.description: Handles toggling of IP modes (IPv4/IPv6) in interfaces.

methods.name: void _ipv4_mode_toggled(UNUSED const char * const event_name,const amxc_var_t * const event_data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Event handler for IPv4 mode toggle events.

methods.name: void _ipv6_mode_toggled(UNUSED const char * const event_name,const amxc_var_t * const event_data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Event handler for IPv6 mode toggle events.

methods.name: void _app_start(UNUSED const char * const event_name,UNUSED const amxc_var_t * const event_data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Initialization event handler triggered at application start, registers WAN interfaces for sensing queries.
